_about: Cell-level battery chemistry database for the EV simulator. EVERY numeric value below is PER CELL unless the key name says otherwise. A pack is built by choosing a series count S and a parallel count P in BatteryPack(S, P, chemistry).

_field_notes.nominal_v: Nominal / nameplate cell voltage in volts.
_field_notes.max_v: Maximum safe charge voltage per cell (V).
_field_notes.min_v: Minimum safe discharge voltage per cell (V) - pack cutoff.
_field_notes.cell_resistance_mohm: Cell DC internal resistance in milliohms (fresh, 25 C).
_field_notes.max_cont_discharge_A: Maximum continuous discharge current per cell (A).
_field_notes.max_burst_A: Short-duration burst discharge current per cell (A).
_field_notes.max_cont_charge_A: Maximum continuous charge (regen) current per cell (A).
_field_notes.cell_capacity_Ah: Rated capacity per cell (Ah) at the 1C / 1h reference rate.
_field_notes.peukert_exponent: Peukert exponent k. ~1.0 for lithium, 1.25-1.35 for lead-acid. Used to scale usable capacity at high discharge rates.
_field_notes.coulombic_efficiency: Fraction of discharged charge that is actually delivered (1.0 = ideal).
_field_notes.charge_efficiency: Fraction of charge current that is stored (regen losses).
_field_notes.ocv_curve: Open-circuit-voltage curve as [[soc, volts], ...] with soc in 0..1. Must be shape-realistic, NOT a straight line.
_field_notes.cell_thermal_mass_J_K: Lumped thermal capacity of one cell (J/K).
_field_notes.cell_cooling_W_K: Lumped convection coefficient to ambient per cell (W/K).
_field_notes.derate_start_C: Cell temperature (C) at which continuous discharge power begins to derate.
_field_notes.max_cell_temp_C: Cell temperature (C) at which discharge power derates to zero.
_field_notes.soc_taper_start: SOC below which available discharge power tapers toward the floor.
_field_notes.cycle_life: Indicative full-depth cycle life; informational only.
_field_notes._todo: Values flagged with a _todo key need datasheet verification before use in engineering studies.

Pb-Acid._todo: cell_resistance_mohm, cell_thermal_mass_J_K and cell_cooling_W_K are typical values; verify against the actual datasheet.

Li-Ion (NMC)._todo: cell_resistance_mohm depends strongly on cell format (pouch vs prismatic); verify with datasheet.

LiFePO4._todo: The flat LFP plateau makes SOC estimation hard; consider adding a lookup-based estimator later.

LiPo._todo: High-C pouch cells sag and puff when abused; treat the thermal model as indicative only.

NiMH._todo: NiMH has strong voltage depression under load; verify max_cont_discharge_A with datasheet.

custom._todo: Replace every value in this template with real cell data before use.
